purpose: Assemble a split system: identity = E191 branch A v3 (frozen), gate = E192's frozen gate artifact (E65 correlation-logSPD WCCN distance_ratio). Measure the E192 gate's Test S1/S2 curve, fuse it with E191's subwin6 gate, and report the full ten-gate matrix at a single work point. No model is retrained and nothing is written into another experiment directory.

frozen_sources.note: E191 provides model_branch_a_v3.pt and cache/stage_a_v3.pt; E192 provides gate.json + cache/gate_arrays.npz + model_final20.pt; E189 provides subwin6 gate arrays, the attack subset and the frozen gate scorer definitions; E180 provides data/model utilities.

gate_identity_clarification.finding: E192's gate artifact is NOT trained with the external BCIC IV-2a unknowns. In E192 the gate is the E65 correlation-logSPD WCCN distance_ratio; the external OE data only enters the identity branch (ARPL + outlier exposure).
gate_identity_clarification.consequence: This experiment measures the gate artifact that E192 actually produced, and additionally probes an OE-informed gate built from the frozen E192 model_final20.pt embeddings (supplementary, cannot enter #5/#6 because no LOSO OE models exist).

protocol.note: identical to E191/E192; the window rows never enter any gate fitting or threshold calibration

identity.oof: #2/#3 from the 5-block OOF logits; #4 on frac > 0.6 rows exactly as E191
identity.ra_asafe: identity logits recomputed on the attacked waveforms of the E189 attack subset

gate.oe_stream: E192 gate.json / cache/gate_arrays.npz: E65 correlation-logSPD (855 dim) WCCN distance_ratio, 20-class global prototypes
gate.subwin_stream: E189 subwin6_pca96_k1: subwin_mean N=6, PCA-96, k=1 nearest prototype, task conditional
gate.threshold_rule: tau(a) = quantile(Train 5-block OOF score, 1 - a); a = Train known acceptance
gate.fusion_rule: z-score each stream by its own Train OOF mean/std, then 0.1-step simplex weight search maximising pooled Train LOSO AUROC; Test never consulted
gate.probe: supplementary OE-embedding gate from the frozen E192 model_final20.pt (distance_ratio and max-cosine); threshold calibrated on the Train window (the E192 identity model is trained on fit rows only, so the window is held out). Not eligible for #5/#6.

attack.subset: E189.attack_subset: Train window rows, stratified cap 400 per task, same seed
attack.radius: per-trial L2 norm after channel demeaning / 10^(SNR/20)

goals.A: impersonation: maximise (best wrong E191 logit - true logit)/10
goals.B: broad confusion: maximise (logsumexp over wrong E191 logits - true logit)/10
goals.C: boundary impersonation: maximise (next-identity logit - true logit)/10
goals.D: gate acceptance: maximise the selected gate score (scheme specific)

attack.reading: #7 = min RA over clean + A/B/C/D at both SNR levels; #8 = min ASafeR over the same; SNR30-only worst is reported alongside (E192's primary SNR)

gates.7: RA under the self-built PGD, worst over eps x goals >= 0.95
gates.criterion_note: user criterion: S1 >= 0.70 AND S2 >= 0.70 at the same work point, plus the other eight gates

reporting.test_official: N/A: Test has no public identity labels
reporting.session_usage: Test scores are computed before the Session column is read; Session is used only for the #9/#10 audit
reporting.single_work_point: every counted column is one scheme at one a; nothing is spliced across work points
